history.p: It was in the 1840's that Gade's teacher, the composer and organist A.P. Berggreen (1801-80), started publishing the collection "Folke-Sange og Melodier", involving his pupil in the work. This coincides with Gade's own collection of piano arrangements of Scandinavian Folk Songs.
